scope: API authentication matrix: session cookie, OAuth login/callback, auth middleware, unauthenticated/expired/revoked sessions, login/logout/status consistency between UI and API.

contracts.v2Mount: v2Router.use(requireAuth) applies to every /api/v2 route before domain routers.
contracts.requireAuth: Missing userId/discordId => 401. userId/discordId without persistent sessionToken => 401 SESSION_REVOKED. Every supplied sessionToken must resolve to an active, unexpired, user-bound Prisma Session row; otherwise 401 SESSION_REVOKED + cookie destroyed.
contracts.oauth: Discord-only OAuth with state/nonce/PKCE; regenerate the Express session before binding identity; session.save before redirects.
contracts.logout: Deactivates Prisma Session.isActive, clears tokenCache, destroys express-session.
contracts.status: /auth/status verifies the Prisma Session on every request, including OAuth token-cache hits; inactive/expired/user-mismatched rows return authenticated false.
contracts.apiMe: /api/me uses the same canonical persistent-session requireAuth as /api/v2 — unauthenticated or unbound legacy cookie => 401.
contracts.storeFailure: Session DB lookup failure => 503 SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE fail-closed (no anonymous elevation).
